name: 陳家祥
objective:
1. Students will learn and master the basic skills of soccer including passing, trapping, dribbling, shooting, and defending.
2. Students will understand and apply the basic rules and tactical concepts of soccer.
3. Students will improve their physical fitness, focusing on speed, agility, endurance, and coordination.
4. Students will cultivate sportsmanship, teamwork, and fair play.

1. 學生將學習並熟練足球的基本技術（傳球、停球、運球、投籃、防守等）。
2. 學生將理解並應用足球的基本規則與戰術概念。
3. 學生將提升體能，特別是速度、敏捷、耐力及協調性。
4. 學生將培養運動精神、團隊合作與公平競爭的態度。

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
